data.title: 粉色卧室里的蓝色睡衣
data.location: 洒满晨光的柔和粉色卧室床铺
data.camera: 略俯视斜角半身近景横幅
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, nene_blue_pajamas, sky blue button-up pajamas, cat animal print, pink collar trim, long sleeves, sitting on bed, legs tucked sideways, hair spread across shoulders, hands resting on pink quilt, slight blush, drowsy gentle gaze, looking up at viewer, pastel pink pillows, morning window light, dutch angle, from above, medium close-up
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the pastel pink quilt in her sky-blue cat-print pajamas with her silver hair spilled loose across her shoulders, she looks up from a gentle tilt with sleepy shyness. Soft morning window light warms the pillows and highlights her pink-trimmed collar.
data.promptProse: Captured from a slightly tilted overhead angle across a cozy pastel bedroom, Ayachi Nene sits curled on rumpled pink bedding just after waking. She wears her canonical sky-blue long-sleeved button-up pajamas printed with tiny cat motifs and edged with a soft pink collar, her long silver hair tumbling unfastened around her shoulders as her hands rest lightly on the quilt. Fresh morning sunlight enters diagonally from a nearby window, softly illuminating her sleepy blush, parted lips, and the plush pillows nestled behind her.
data.story: 刚睡醒的卧室还带着暖烘烘的被窝气息。穿着天蓝小猫睡衣的宁宁坐在粉色被褥间，银白长发松松散在肩头，听见你叫她才带着一点睡意抬起眼睛——「早安……再让我靠着枕头缓一分钟嘛。」
